## Technology Highlights

### Backend Stack:
- Spring Boot 3.2+
- Spring Security 6.x with JWT (JJWT 0.12.x)
- Spring Data JPA + Hibernate 6.x
- PostgreSQL 15+
- Flyway 10.x for migrations
- Springdoc OpenAPI 2.x (Swagger)
- JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers

### Frontend Stack:
- React 18+ with TypeScript 5.x
- Vite 5.x (build tool)
- Tailwind CSS 3.x
- shadcn/ui (Radix UI components)
- TanStack Query v5 (data fetching)
- React Router v6
- React Hook Form + Zod
- Recharts (data visualization)
- Vitest + Testing Library

### Key Features:
- ✓ JWT-based stateless authentication
- ✓ Role-based access control (Owner/Admin/Viewer)
- ✓ Multi-user household expense sharing
- ✓ Recurring transaction detection (rule-based AI)
- ✓ Advanced budgets with rollover
- ✓ Predictive spending insights
- ✓ Interactive charts and analytics
- ✓ CSV and PDF export
- ✓ Docker containerization
- ✓ Separate deployment strategy
